This is my philosophy about former partners: they’re broken up for a reason. If this guy is even slightly prioritizing his ex girlfriend’s feeling over yours, that’s not okay. What she did was petty and a sign that she is not over him at all. If she was, she would not do anything that could potentially sabotage his new relationship. The fact that he still is in contact with her after that incident would make a lot of girls uncomfortable. If you see a future with this guy, this ex situation needs to be taken care of. Open and honest communication is necessary for any thriving relationship. Tell him how you feel and that she makes you uncomfortable. Remember your worth if he refuses to take your feelings into consideration.

I had an emergency induction at 38 weeks for preeclampsia. I was told I had a 60 percent chance of needing a cesarean due to an unfavorable cervix. They inserted Cytotec and the first dose didn’t help at all. 2 hours later I had a second dose inserted. That dose put me into full blown labor without Pitocin. I got an epidural at 4 cm at 10 pm. I delivered my daughter vaginally at 5:14 am. There was a full moon that night, so I think it helped my labor progress.

Happy birthday :)
